question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Glimpse
solution: The correct answer is **"Glance."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • A **"glimpse"** means a quick look or a brief view. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का संक्षिप्‍त और अधूरा दृश्‍य; झाँकी, झलक) • **Example**: *I just managed to catch a **glimpse**__ of the fox’s tail as it ran down a hole.* • Synonyms for **glimpse** include **glance, **and** peek.** • **"Glance" **means a quick look. (उड़ती नज़र) __ • **Example**: *She need to take a **glance**__.* The correct answer is **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Vision (Option 1)** refers to the ability to see or perceive something. (देखने की क्षमता; दृष्टि, नज़र) • **Gawk (Option 3) **means to stare openly in a rude or awkward manner. (खुलेआम अशिष्ट या अजीब तरीके से घूरना) • **See through (Option 4)** means to understand the true nature of something or to see past someone's lies or deception. (किसी चीज़ की वास्तविक प्रकृति को समझना या किसी के झूठ या धोखे से परे देखना) 4e:T9ac, The correct answer is **"Consientious."**
